name: SIA 323 发动机失效 积冰/防冰 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: Your call sign is SIA 323, a flight from Wuhan to SIA, you are at gate 215, with information C, request ATC clearance from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 SIA 323，航班从武汉飞往 SIA，位于 215 号停机位，已收到 C 情报，向武汉放行请求空中交通管制许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA 323, Gate 215, information C, request ATC clearance to SIA.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA 323，215 号停机位，C 情报，请求飞往 SIA 的空中交通管制许可。

cards.audioText: SIA 323, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to SIA via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, follow LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1,800 meters, cruising level 10,400 meters, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3763.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 323，武汉放行，许可按飞行计划航路飞往 SIA，离场使用 Runway 36R，执行 LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至 1,800 米，巡航高度 10,400 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 3763。
cards.referenceText: cleared to SIA via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, LKO-01 departure, 1800 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, 119.7, squawk 3763, SIA 323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往 SIA，离场使用 Runway 36R，执行 LKO-01 离场，1800 米，巡航高度 10400 米，119.7，应答机 3763，SIA 323。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 323, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 323，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 323, push back and start up approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 323，推出和开车批准，机头向东。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing east, SIA 323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，机头向东，SIA 323。

cards.audioText: During pushback, a ground truck has broken down ahead of you and blocked your way, you have stopped the aircraft, ask Wuhan Ground for a tug to tow the vehicle away.
cards.audioTextZh: 推出期间，前方一辆地面车辆发生故障并挡住去路。你已停住航空器，向武汉地面请求拖车将车辆拖走。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 323, a ground truck has broken down ahead of us and blocked our way, we have stopped the aircraft, request a tug to tow the vehicle away.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 323，前方一辆地面车辆发生故障并挡住我们的去路，我们已停住航空器，请求拖车将车辆拖走。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 323, hold position, the tug will come soon.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 323，保持位置，牵引车很快会来。

cards.audioText: now you are at holding point Runway 36R, you notice the wind sock shows strong tailwind, ask Wuhan Tower to check the wind.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你位于 Runway 36R 等待点，发现风向袋显示强顺风，请武汉塔台检查风况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 323, holding point Runway 36R, the wind sock shows strong tailwind, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 323，位于 Runway 36R 等待点，风向袋显示强顺风，请求检查风况。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 323, wind 200 degrees, 8 meters per second.
B: the tailwind exceeds your takeoff limit, ask Wuhan Tower to change to Runway 18L for departure.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： SIA 323，风向 200 度，风速 8 米/秒。
B： 顺风超过你的起飞限制，请求武汉塔台改用 Runway 18L 离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 323, roger, the tailwind exceeds our takeoff limit, request change to Runway 18L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 323，收到，顺风超过我们的起飞限制，请求改用 Runway 18L。

cards.audioText: SIA 323, taxi via A, A3, T and N to Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 323，经 A、A3、T 和 N 滑行至 Runway 18L。
cards.referenceText: taxi via A, A3, T and N to Runway 18L, SIA 323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 A、A3、T 和 N 滑行至 Runway 18L，SIA 323。

cards.audioText:
SIA 323, can you accept intersection departure from J Runway 18L?
tell the controller you can't accept it because of performance limitation and you need full length departure Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh:
SIA 323，能否接受从 J 进入 Runway 18L 做交叉口离场？
告诉管制员，因性能限制你不能接受，需要使用 Runway 18L 全跑道长度离场。
cards.referenceText: negative intersection departure from J due performance, request full length departure Runway 18L, SIA 323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不行，因性能原因不能从 J 做交叉口离场，请求使用 Runway 18L 全跑道长度离场，SIA 323。

cards.audioText: SIA 323, roger, taxi via J, line up Runway 18L and backtrack.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 323，收到，经 J 滑行，进入 Runway 18L 对正并反向滑行。
cards.referenceText: taxi via J, line up Runway 18L and backtrack, SIA 323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 J 滑行，进入 Runway 18L 对正并反向滑行，SIA 323。

cards.audioText: Now you are holding short of Runway 18L, you are ready for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你在 Runway 18L 外等待，已准备好离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 323, holding short of Runway 18L, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 323，在 Runway 18L 外等待，已准备好离场。

cards.audioText: now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, contact Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已升空，正通过 600 米，联系武汉离场。
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，SIA 323，正通过 600 米。

cards.audioText: SIA 323, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, turn right, direct to WHA, climb to and maintain 3000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 323，武汉离场，雷达已识别，右转直飞 WHA，爬升至并保持 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: turn right, direct to WHA, climb to and maintain 3000 meters, SIA 323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 WHA，爬升至并保持 3000 米，SIA 323。

cards.audioText: B: During climb, you hear loud noise coming from the left engine, and the instrument shows the EGT of port engine exceeds temperature limit, report this situation to ATC and hold for check.
cards.audioTextZh: B：爬升过程中，你听到左发有巨大噪音，仪表显示左发 EGT 超温，向 ATC 报告情况并请求等待检查。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, SIA 323, we hear loud noise coming from the left engine, and the instrument shows the EGT of port engine exceeds temperature limit, request hold for check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，SIA 323，我们听到左发有巨大噪音，仪表显示左发 EGT 超温，请求等待检查。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 323, hold at WHA VOR as published.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 323，按公布程序在 WHA VOR 等待。
cards.referenceText: Hold at WHA VOR as published, SIA 323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按公布程序在 WHA VOR 等待，SIA 323。

cards.audioText: you have shut down the port engine, request leave the hold and return for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已关停左发动机，请求退出等待并返场着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, SIA 323, we have shut down the port engine, request leave the hold and return for landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，SIA 323，我们已关停左发动机，请求退出等待并返场着陆。
